name: section
title: Section
description: A two-column section layout with a title/description header on the left and content area on the right. Uses namespace exports: Section.Root, Section.Header, Section.Title, Section.Description, Section.Content, Section.Section (composed).

docs.lead: A two-column section layout for organizing form fields and content with a descriptive header.
docs.usage:
import * as Section from "@/components/ui/section"

// Composed (recommended)
<Section.Section title="Title" description="Description">
  {children}
</Section.Section>

// Namespace
<Section.Root>
  <Section.Header>
    <Section.Title>Title</Section.Title>
    <Section.Description>Description</Section.Description>
  </Section.Header>
  <Section.Content>
    {children}
  </Section.Content>
</Section.Root>

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Simplified single-component API with title and description as props.
examples.code:
<Section.Section
  title="Enter your business details"
  description="Share the key details about your business."
>
  {children}
</Section.Section>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Standard two-column section with title, description, and form content using namespace pattern.
examples.code:
